name: night-agent-backend
description: Webhooks, dashboard API and worker for Night Agent

scripts.jwt-keys: mkdir -p ../keys && test ! -f ../keys/jwt-private.pem && openssl genrsa -out ../keys/jwt-private.pem 2048 && openssl rsa -in ../keys/jwt-private.pem -pubout -out ../keys/jwt-public.pem && chmod 600 ../keys/jwt-private.pem && echo 'JWT keys created in keys/' || echo 'keys/jwt-private.pem already exists, left unchanged'
